keySentence: He was brave enough to tell the truth.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Tom was afraid of Injun Joe. But Muff Potter was innocent. Tom went to court. He was brave enough to tell the truth.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Tom was terrified because Injun Joe was a very dangerous man. But innocent Muff Potter was suffering in prison for nothing. Tom gathered all his courage and went to the courtroom. He was brave enough to tell the truth in front of everyone. He pointed at Injun Joe and told the judge what really happened. The whole courtroom gasped when they heard Tom's brave words.
facts.Word cards: court = 법정 / bravely = 용감하게 / silent = 조용한 / trembled = 떨렸다
